_doc: The slot of MakerBeam, the 10 x 10 mm beam: 3 mm between lips 1 mm thick, and 3 mm deep to a 4 mm square core. Under the lips it widens to about 6 mm in a pocket on each side with a slanted roof, which holds the square head of MakerBeam's M3 bolt: the bolt slides in from an end and the nut goes on outside. Opening, lip and depth are printed on MakerBeam's drawing; the width under the lips, the floor and the slant are scaled off it, and say so. The drawn slot leaves out the rounds.
name: slot-3-makerbeam

opening.rule: Between the lips: 3 on the drawing (corner blocks of 3,5 each side of it)
opening.source: MakerBeam B.V., technical drawing 100168 "beam clear anodised, M3, Ø2.5" (L = 100 mm, 18-4-2017), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the underside of the lip: 1 on the drawing
lip_thickness.source: MakerBeam B.V., technical drawing 100168 "beam clear anodised, M3, Ø2.5" (L = 100 mm, 18-4-2017), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips, at the tips of the two pockets: 5.95 by the drawing's scale. Not dimensioned: measure yours
cavity_width.source: scaled off MakerBeam B.V., technical drawing 100168 "beam clear anodised, M3, Ø2.5" (L = 100 mm, 18-4-2017), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/ (the drawing prints no figure for it)

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the core: 3 on the drawing (the core is a 4 mm square in a 10 mm section)
cavity_depth.source: MakerBeam B.V., technical drawing 100168 "beam clear anodised, M3, Ø2.5" (L = 100 mm, 18-4-2017), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

floor_width.rule: Width of the flat floor in the middle, about 2.1 mm: each side of it the roof slants out to the pocket's tip. Not dimensioned
floor_width.source: scaled off MakerBeam B.V., technical drawing 100168 "beam clear anodised, M3, Ø2.5" (L = 100 mm, 18-4-2017), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/ (the drawing prints no figure for it)

flank_angle.rule: The slant of the pockets' roofs, about 38 degrees from the face's plane: they reach the full width about 1.5 mm below the face. Not dimensioned
flank_angle.source: scaled off MakerBeam B.V., technical drawing 100168 "beam clear anodised, M3, Ø2.5" (L = 100 mm, 18-4-2017), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/ (the drawing prints no figure for it)

nut_family.rule: It takes the head of MakerBeam's M3 square headed bolt ("M3 square headed bolts for MakerBeam", with "Regular M3 DIN934 nuts" outside); a plain M3 nut does not go in
nut_family.source: MakerBeam B.V., "overview specifications MB, MBXL, OB with pictures" (20161130), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/
